name: Email Manager for Contact Form 7
author: Artilab Company LTD

sections.description:
Features:
– Add a global email that applies to all forms.
– Remove a specific email from all forms.
– Edit email recipients for each form individually.
– Ensure all changes are applied instantly without manual updates in each form.

This plugin simplifies email management in CF7, making it easy to add, remove, and update email recipients for multiple forms at once.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/email-manager-cf7 directory or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Contact > Email Settings” in the WordPress admin panel to configure the email addresses.
sections.faq:
How does this plugin modify Contact Form 7 emails?

The plugin updates the recipient field in the CF7 mail settings for each form based on the inputs from the settings page.

Can I add multiple email addresses?

Yes, you can add multiple email addresses separated by commas.

Will this plugin work with other CF7 add-ons?

The plugin modifies the core mail recipient settings of CF7, so it should work fine with most add-ons. However, it’s recommended to test for compatibility.
